id: p1 pattern of b (separate copies), hole on the pattern
script: const b = box(40, 40, 20); const p = linearPattern(b, { count: 3, step: [60, 0, 0] }); hole(p, { across: 6 });

id: p2 pattern of b, other part far, hole on other
script: const b = box(40, 40, 20); const p = linearPattern(b, { count: 3, step: [60, 0, 0] }); const o = box(20, 20, 10, { at: [0, 300, 0] }); hole(o, { across: 6 });

id: p3 other part, pattern of b, hole on the pattern
script: const o = box(20, 20, 10, { at: [0, 300, 0] }); const b = box(40, 40, 20); const p = linearPattern(b, { count: 3, step: [60, 0, 0] }); hole(p, { across: 6 });

id: p4 touching pattern (fused), other part, hole on pattern
script: const o = box(20, 20, 10, { at: [0, 300, 0] }); const b = box(40, 40, 20); const p = linearPattern(b, { count: 3, step: [40, 0, 0] }); hole(p, { across: 6 });

id: p5 mirror of b, other far, hole on other
script: const b = box(40, 40, 20); const m = mirror(b, "yz"); const o = box(20, 20, 10, { at: [0, 300, 0] }); hole(o, { across: 6 });

id: p6 cut that splits b in two, other far, hole on other
script: const b = box(40, 40, 20); const k = cuboid(10, 60, 40); subtract(b, k); const o = box(20, 20, 10, { at: [0, 300, 0] }); hole(o, { across: 6 });

id: p7 cut that splits b in two, hole on b (two pieces)
script: const b = box(40, 40, 20); const k = cuboid(10, 60, 40); const s = subtract(b, k); hole(s, { across: 6, at: [12, 0] });

id: p8 two joined parts + third, hole on the join
script: const b = box(40, 40, 20); const c = box(40, 40, 20, { at: [30, 0, 0] }); const j = union(b, c); const o = box(20, 20, 10, { at: [0, 300, 0] }); hole(j, { across: 6 });
